parent_objective: validate current-base compatibility for hidden capability-step fault-event source mining
blocked_by: M989 admits only a small no-training smoke before source mining or training

public_gates: M990 must not change actor inputs
M990 must keep hidden fault labels as logging/pairing metadata only
M990 must report model fidelity limits
M990 must not require accepted rows at smoke scale
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add hidden event labels to actor observations
do not claim true per-wheel/asymmetric faults

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_scenario_family: current-base hidden capability-step/fault event compatibility
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: creates a minimal current-base fault-event config and smoke-runs the existing cross-fault source harness before larger mining
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: infrastructure smoke only; no training, no promotion, no proof-positive claim unless rows appear incidentally
stop_condition: stop if checkpoint/config observation compatibility fails
stop if artifacts are missing or hidden labels enter actor observation
stop if model fidelity limits are not written
fallback_plan: if M974 is incompatible with the old fault-event env config, create a P0 72-dim env config matching the M974 actor contract
if no matched pairs appear, loosen matching windows or adjust activation timing in a new pre-registered milestone
if smoke passes, route to larger no-training source mining
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M989 design admits a minimal no-training capability-step smoke

hypothesis: The existing fault-event corpus harness can be run against the M974 public-gate base with a small current-base capability-step config while preserving the P0 actor contract.
failure_criteria: no snapshots or matched pairs are produced
hidden fault/event labels enter actor observations

commands.name: smoke
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.extreme_dynamics_scenario_corpus --checkpoint runs/m974_exact_repair_from_base_s40_seed5974/candidate_checkpoint.pt --config configs/m990_capability_step_fault_scenarios.json --pairing-mode cross_fault --seed-start 99000 --seed-count 64 --device auto --run-dir runs/m990_v4_public_base_capability_step_fault_smoke

decision_rule: M990 passes only if the no-training fault-event harness produces core artifacts and matched pairs without actor/input mutation. Accepted rows are reported but not required.
